It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 10, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }} The district consists of the provincial capital [[Balanga, Bataan|Balanga]] and adjacent eastern Bataan municipalities of [[Limay]], [[Orion, Bataan|Orion]] and [[Pilar, Bataan|Pilar]]. The southwestern municipalities of [[Bagac]] and [[Mariveles, Bataan|Mariveles]] were once part of the district until these were reassigned to the [[Bataan's 3rd congressional district|third district]] effective 2022.{{Cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=11153|title=An Act Providing for the Reapportionment of the Province of Bataan into Three (3) Legislative Districts |url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/2021/06/24/republic-act-no-11553/|date=June 24, 2021 |access-date=November 14, 2024 |language=en-US}} It is currently represented in the [[19th Congress of the Philippines|19th Congress]] by [[Albert Garcia]] of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] (NUP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 10, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
